abstract: One hundred ninety-four patients with pathologically confirmed molar pregnancy and intact uteri were studied prospectively. Group A included 177 patients in whom the beta subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG-beta) declined to normal (less than 5 mlU/ml) without chemotherapy, whereas group B included 17 patients with invasive complications in the postmolar phase which necessitated the use of chemotherapy. Only women with intact uteri were included in the study. In group A, there were no significant differences in the human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) positive interval between women who used intrauterine contraceptive devices, barrier and other methods, and those who used oral contraceptives. Differences in the proportions of women in groups A and B who used the oral contraceptives and intrauterine contraceptive devices were not observed. However, the mean dosage of estrogen and the proportion of women who ingested more than 50 micrograms of estrogen were higher in group B. These data suggest that (1) the oral contraceptives with less than 50 micrograms of estrogen and the intrauterine contraceptive devices do not prolong the hCG-beta positive interval nor increase the risk of invasive complications in the postmolar phase which requires the use of chemotherapy; and (2) the dose of estrogen (in formulations that contain more than 50 micrograms) rather than the oral contraceptives per se may influence the risk of these postmolar complications.
abstract_ja: 胞状奇胎と病理学的に確認され、子宮を温存した194例を前向きに検討した。A群は177例で、化学療法なしにヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニット(hCG-β)が正常値(5 mIU/ml未満)まで低下した。B群は17例で、胞状奇胎後期に侵襲性合併症を生じ、化学療法を要した。研究対象は子宮を温存した女性のみとした。A群では、子宮内避妊器具、バリア法その他の方法を用いた女性と、経口避妊薬を用いた女性との間で、hCG陽性期間に有意差はなかった。A群とB群で経口避妊薬と子宮内避妊器具の使用割合に差は認められなかった。しかし、B群ではエストロゲンの平均用量と、50 µgを超えるエストロゲンを摂取した女性の割合が高かった。これらのデータから、(1) 50 µg未満のエストロゲンを含む経口避妊薬および子宮内避妊器具は、hCG-β陽性期間を延長せず、化学療法を要する胞状奇胎後の侵襲性合併症のリスクを高めない、(2) 胞状奇胎後の合併症リスクに影響するのは、経口避妊薬そのものよりも、50 µgを超える含量の製剤におけるエストロゲン用量である、と示唆された。
